text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I arrive at the training track…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Keep going! Start like you mean to go on—without ever giving an inch!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Haaaaah…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Goody-good job! That last stretch was super rough, huh?
choice_data_list: Doing some partner running with an underclassman?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yep! She's a funny one, y'know. She said she wanted to make me her mentor, so I'm helping her out!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not a funny one! You just always look like you're having sooo much fun when you're running!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: And you totally dominate races as a front runner! Plus your form is incredible! And really cool! Watching your races just really gets me in the feels—you're awesome!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: One day, I want to run in a turf G1 race as a front runner, and win just like—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okey dokey! Sounds to me like you've got enough energy to run another lap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I mean, you're gonna do great in your next scrimmage, then take me on in a G1, right?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …Yes! I am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I hear that the Umamusume Ines Fujin trained with is running in a scrimmage, so we both head over to the track to watch.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Ngh… Gaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Come on…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The runner we're there to see gradually falls further and further behind, and in the end… she places ninth.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, that was great. You really gave it your all until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I-Ines… I… I…

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …! Hey, wait—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin and I search for the younger Umamusume. I think Ines may have noticed the same thing I did.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the while that young runner was leading the pack on that turf track, she had a pained look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ines…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, so… you weren't exactly having fun being out in front, huh?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …! How did you…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I can tell. My whole thing is being the Umamusume who goes out onto the track to have a blast, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So listen… it's okay for you to run the way you most enjoy. Just 'cause you look up to someone doesn't mean you have to be them.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But you… you even shared your front-running tips with me! How could I…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't worry about it. That time we spent training was fun for the both of us! It was a great experience, right? That's good enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm me, and you're you. And the only one who can really enjoy the fun you have… is you, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ines…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, I hear that the very same Umamusume won a dirt scrimmage as a late surger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, after winning, she had a big grin on her mud-covered face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of fun she'll find once she makes her debut…
choice_data_list: What kind of fun would you like to find next?
What kind of fun would you like to find next?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're gonna throw it back to me? Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I think I'll stay a front runner, so I can run, run, and run some more, and win a ton of G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Cause that's what's most fun for me.
choice_data_list: Then you've got my full support with that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yep. And I'm glad to have it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin and I gaze out at the track where the other Umamusume are running. Then, after about five minutes, we get started on our own training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to have loads more fun like I'm having now! My parents are both good to go, and my sisters are chasing their dreams too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna burn brighter than even the sun up high, and have a blast while I'm at it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Shining brightly for everyone to see—tell me that doesn't sound like a good time!
choice_data_list: Sounds like this sun's still raring to glow.
Sounds like this sun's still raring to glow.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Exactly! My fun's just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin takes off toward the track, as passionate today as she's ever been.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run in tons more G1 races, and pull way, way, way far ahead of the pack! I'll leave everything in the dust—even defeat itself!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'll keep on running and running, holding on to that lead for as long as I can! 'Cause that way…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can savor every second of this miraculous moment where your fun and my fun are one and the same.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm just wishing that things could stay this way—the way I like—forever.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer…
choice_data_list: Let's keep aiming for victory together.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Yeah, let's win! Let's win way, way more races!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let's win and win and win! I'm not gonna let this fun dream ever come to an end!
